description: This file defines the ServerRequestInterface, which is a PHP interface representing an incoming server-side HTTP request. It extends RequestInterface and specifies methods for accessing server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and request attributes, emphasizing immutability. The interface is part of the PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces standard.

classes.name: ServerRequestInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface defining the structure for server-side HTTP request objects, including methods for accessing and modifying request metadata such as server parameters, headers, query parameters, cookies, uploaded files, request body, and attributes, all while maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieve server parameters, typically derived from $_SERVER, in an immutable fashion.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieve cookies sent by the client.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified cookie parameters, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified query parameters, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Retrieve uploaded files metadata, returning an array of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified uploaded files.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieve body parameters, such as those deserialized from JSON, form data, etc.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified parsed body parameters.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieve custom attributes derived from the request.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieve a single attribute, with an optional default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute removed.
